intro: Gryphon Master Talonaxe hands you a feather taken from the gryphon child Sharpbeak's nest. You are to carry it to the diviner Thadius Grimshade, who dwells in Nethergarde Keep's mage tower in the Blasted Lands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this feather to Thadius Grimshade, the diviner. He left Aerie Peak years ago to pursue darker knowledge, but in his heart he is still a Wildhammer!
And perhaps his talents can help us find Sharpbeak.
This feather was taken from the nest where the gryphon child sleeps. If you give it to Thadius then, with luck, he can use his divining magics to find Sharpbeak.
Good luck, friend. You will find Thadius in the Blasted Lands, in the mage tower of Nethergarde Keep.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, you come bearing a gift?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, yes. This feather belongs to a fine gryphon. One destined for great things... If he can survive into adulthood undamaged.
You wish to find him? Then listen close, brave adventurer...
